Given the classic "slapped cheek" facial rash followed by a lacy, reticular rash on the trunk and extremities, along with the preceding viral prodrome, this presentation is highly characteristic of Erythema Infectiosum (Fifth Disease) caused by Parvovirus B19.

DIAGNOSIS READY: Erythema Infectiosum (Fifth Disease)
